name: PermLatch_AOI
revision_note: Implements AL-1605-0840 S09-07-095000..095080 for one permissive. Placeholder until the official ALS-U Git AOI (e.g. biLatch_AOI) is loaded into templates/.
description: One permissive of an interlock group: latch on trip, first-fault arbitration via UDT_PermGroup, bypass, operator reset

parameters.name: Byp
parameters.description: Bypass, 1 = active (signal ignored, latch stays permit after reset)

parameters.name: Rst
parameters.description: Operator reset request, 1 = reset latched and first-fault bits

parameters.name: Grp
parameters.description: Interlock group this permissive belongs to (Trip_Sts and FF_Sts maintained here)

parameters.name: Ltch
parameters.description: Latched trip, 1 = tripped (held until reset with Sts normal or Byp)

parameters.name: FF
parameters.description: First fault, 1 = this permissive triggered the current trip event

parameters.name: Permit
parameters.description: 1 = permissive satisfied (normal or bypassed) and not latched

local_tags.name: Trip_OSS
local_tags.description: One-shot storage for a new trip event
